snippet.title: Cold Abyss - Official Gameplay Trailer | Indie Horror Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Cold Abyss is a relaxing and atmospheric exploration game where your job is to dive down deep into the ocean and repair internet cables. While it may seem scary, there are no enemies or other forms of danger, it’s just you. But maybe that’s the scary part? Cold Abyss is coming soon to PC.
